## Worker: background processing {#sec-worker}

<!-- TODO: If your project has background workers, keep this section.
Note: always close the Python fence and end the file with a newline —
an unclosed fence swallows Quarto's trailing metadata comments and leaks
them into the PDF. -->

```python
while True:
    _, payload = queue.blpop("job_queue", timeout=30)
    if not payload:
        continue
    result = worker(payload)
    key = f"result:{payload.correlation_id}"
    store.set(key, result)
```
